objective: Standard statement: classify every gadget with at most five triangles (up to relabeling) by exactness of the generic standing wave and of signed not-all-equal, by mechanism (locking, cancellation, angle-specific), and by the growth exponent of its tower; locate the Sierpinski gadget among them. Nearest known result: ticket A. Classification: to be decided.
status: Proved by SPACE-SELECTION-20261030-001B-P001 (V1): all 74,650 gadgets with at most five triangles classified; the standing wave is generic-exact on 1, 14, 172, 5,694 (locking or balanced cancellation, no algebraic cancellation), signed not-all-equal on 1, 14, 206, 8,584 (3,082 at the knot angle only); on linear gadgets the knot's spaces equal the harmony's up to five triangles; special angles include pi/4, pi/6, pi/8 and cos 2 theta = -1/3; growth rates certified algebraic integers in [2, n-1]; exact counterexamples show the small-size coincidences end at six and seven triangles.
title: Census of small gadgets for the harmony
